trust_boundaries.assumption: Request-derived values never become MarsDB query operators or selectors.

assumption_legs.condition: Request-derived values passed to reviewsCollection and ordersCollection are never interpreted as MarsDB query operators or selector objects.

trust_boundaries.name: Express server to embedded MarsDB

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every query reaches SQLite through Sequelize parameter binding, never concatenated raw SQL.

assumption_legs.condition: Request-derived values reach SQLite only as bound parameters, never as concatenated SQL text.

trust_boundaries.name: App to SQLite: Sequelize parameter binding

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every state-changing or user-specific API route is registered behind security.isAuthorized() before its handler runs.

assumption_legs.condition: Request bodies and parameters on /api and /rest routes are validated before reaching handlers, models or Sequelize queries.
Every user-specific route (baskets, cards, addresses, wallet, chat) is registered behind security.isAuthorized() and verifies the JWT signature.
Each object reference (basket id, card id, address id, order) is checked against the authenticated user id before access.

trust_boundaries.name: Browser to API: security.isAuthorized() middleware

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every /rest/web3 request is treated as attacker-controlled and authorized server-side regardless of the Angular client.

assumption_legs.condition: Bodies of /rest/web3 submitKey, walletNFTVerify and walletExploitAddress are validated before use.
State-affecting /rest/web3 routes require a verified caller credential, not just a client-side guard.
Web3 route handlers check the caller's right to trigger NFT mint/unlock state before acting.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet to Web3 routes: no single control identified

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every authenticated auth/session route is registered behind security.isAuthorized() so a valid RS256-signed JWT is required.

assumption_legs.condition: Login, reset-password, 2FA and address/card request bodies are validated before reaching handlers or queries.
Every state-changing /rest/2fa and /rest/user route except login and reset is registered behind isAuthorized().
Address, card and 2FA operations are checked against the authenticated subject's identity before access.

trust_boundaries.name: Browser to auth API: isAuthorized JWT middleware

trust_boundaries.assumption: Workflows triggered by external pushes and pull requests run without access to release or publishing secrets.

assumption_legs.condition: Workflow steps never interpolate PR-controlled values (branch names, titles) into run: shell scripts unsanitized.
Only pushes by repository collaborators trigger ci.yml with secrets; fork PRs run without secrets.
release.yml GITHUB_TOKEN write access is reachable only from v* tag pushes by authorized maintainers.

trust_boundaries.name: External code into CI: pull_request trigger

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every Socket.IO event payload is treated as untrusted input and validated before it influences server state.

assumption_legs.condition: Payloads of 'notification received' and verify* events are type- and shape-checked before use in findIndex, match or contains.
Socket connections are only accepted from callers the server has identified, since the connection handler performs no auth check.
Events that mutate the shared notifications cache are permitted only for the socket that owns the notification.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet to WebSocket channel: Socket.IO CORS origin check

trust_boundaries.assumption: Every state-changing API route is rejected unless the request carries a valid server-verified session token for the acting user.

assumption_legs.condition: Bodies sent to /api/Addresss, /api/Cards and /rest/2fa/verify are schema-checked server-side before use.
Requests to /api/Addresss, /api/Cards and /rest/2fa/* are accepted only with a valid server-verified token.
Address and card ids in the path are checked against the authenticated user before read or modification.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet to auth and session API

trust_boundaries.assumption: The OAuth access token is returned only to a redirect URI registered for the client ID, and the token is sent only to Google endpoints.

assumption_legs.condition: The access token is never placed in URLs that leak it, since userinfo is called with access_token as a query string parameter.
The authorization redirect and userinfo calls go only to accounts.google.com and www.googleapis.com, with redirect_uri limited to configured authorizedRedirects.
The token and profile returned by Google are treated as untrusted input and verified before they establish a local session.

trust_boundaries.name: Google OAuth sign-in: redirect URI registration

trust_boundaries.assumption: Only content that is safe to disclose to the LLM provider is placed in prompts, and model output is treated as untrusted.

assumption_legs.condition: User messages and the system prompt sent via createOpenAICompatible contain no secrets or data the caller may not disclose.
application.chatBot.llmApiUrl points only to the intended trusted LLM endpoint.
Model output and tool-call arguments (e.g. generateCoupon discount) are validated server-side before being acted upon.

trust_boundaries.name: Chatbot to LLM provider egress

trust_boundaries.assumption: Contract events received from the Alchemy RPC are treated as untrusted input before they drive challenge state.

assumption_legs.condition: Nothing from user requests is sent to the RPC beyond fixed contract addresses and event names.
The WebSocket provider always connects to the hardcoded eth-sepolia.g.alchemy.com host with no request-derived URL component.
Minter and exploiter addresses from NFTMinted and ContractExploited events are only compared to stored sets before solving challenges.

trust_boundaries.name: Web3 surface to Alchemy Sepolia RPC
